description_expanded: Freshly updated with a full exterior renovation and enhanced outdoor furnishings, All Laid Back welcomes you to Seagrove Beach with timeless charm and an inviting sense of ease. This four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath home comfortably sleeps up to ten guests, making it an ideal setting for multi-generational families or a getaway with friends. The gracious columned veranda and classic rocking chairs set the tone on arrival, offering a peaceful place to sip something cool and settle into vacation mode. Painted in a soft coastal blue with crisp white trim, the home’s cottage styling feels bright, cheerful, and unmistakably beach-inspired. Inside, soaring cathedral ceilings and upper-level windows create a dramatic first impression, filling the living space with natural light. The open-concept design is both spacious and welcoming, with comfortable seating in creamy whites and nautical blues, coastal artwork, and light-toned luxury vinyl plank flooring that enhances the airy feel. The kitchen is well-stocked and thoughtfully designed, with quartz countertops, dove-gray beadboard cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and an angled breakfast bar perfect for casual meals or evening appetizers. A warm wood dining table beneath a lantern-style chandelier invites everyone to gather and linger. The first-floor Primary Suite features a king bed, a walk-in closet, a wall-mounted TV, and a private bath with a walk-in shower, along with a convenient powder room and laundry area on this level. Upstairs, an open landing overlooks the living area below, adding to the home’s sense of space. The second Primary Suite offers a king bed, private balcony access, and a spa-like bath complete with double vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. A queen guest bedroom and a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks make this home especially appealing for families traveling with children. The bunk room includes a wall-mounted TV with HDMI connectivity, perfect for gaming or movie nights. A shared Jack-and-Jill bath with individual vanity areas and a walk-in shower connects the guest rooms, providing both comfort and convenience. Out back, the covered and screened lagoon-shaped private pool is a favorite gathering spot, offering just the right size for cooling off and enjoying long afternoons together—without worrying about insects. The outdoor living area includes a grill, dining space, flat-screen TV, and newly updated furnishings that make cookouts and poolside lounging effortless. From the home, it’s approximately a 6–8 minute stroll to the beach access near Eastern Lake, where rare coastal dune waters meet the sugar-white sands and emerald hues of the Gulf. You’re also conveniently close to 30A’s popular restaurants, shops, and grocery options, with easy access to Seaside , Seacrest Beach , Rosemary Beach, and T he Big Chill in Prominence. First Floor: Living Room, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Powder Room, Laundry. Second Floor: King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, Queen Bedroom, Jack and Jill Bath with Walk-In Shower, Bunk Room with Two Twin Bunks and Balcony Access. *Add $50.00 per day to heat the pool (available October - April if needed).
